scope: Aggregate headless simulation metrics from two retained runs. No profile identities, run IDs, native log text or private connection details are included.

phaseDefinitions.activation: First 30 seconds after first active-bot sample.
phaseDefinitions.established: More than 30 seconds after first active-bot sample.
phaseDefinitions.busy: Established samples with at least ten active bots.

nativeAnimationWarningEvidenceLimitation: Previous native per-raid error logs were pruned at startup. Other retained logs cannot prove that animation warnings disappeared.
userReport: The player reported no visible inventory problems.
limitations: Target-bearing bots do not prove shots or successful attacks.
These values measure headless simulation rather than Windows rendered FPS.
Remaining 159–319 ms established-play hitches require correlation; their cause is unproven.
Multi-second loading frames and up to 487 ms activation frames are separate from established play.
Async bot-task completion latency is not a synchronous frame stall.
No retained metrics establish a Reserve headless run in this observation set.
This review does not establish a fresh Windows installation, multiplayer Ground Zero acceptance or a physical host reboot.
